page.content:
Wandering Ansatsuken student who seeks a true warrior's path.

How Ryu connects

  • Faction: World Warriors — Ryu is the wandering center of the World Warriors.
  • Item: Hadoken — Ryu's Hadoken is the signature Ansatsuken fireball.
  • Work: Street Fighter II — Ryu is a starting World Warrior in Street Fighter II.
  • Character: Gouken — Gouken trained Ryu in Ansatsuken.
  • Character: Sagat — Ryu's Shoryuken scarred Sagat and started their rivalry.
  • Character: Akuma — Akuma hunts Ryu as a test of the Satsui no Hadou.
  • Location: Suzaku Castle — Ryu's path keeps returning to Suzaku Castle.

What is Ryu?

Ryu is the white-gi wanderer of Street Fighter: Hadoken, Shoryuken, and a lifelong search for a worthy fight that runs from Suzaku Castle through every World Warrior tournament.

Key threads lead to World Warriors, Hadoken, Street Fighter II, Gouken, Sagat and Akuma.
